dimensions.description: meme-id: meme_image; hasOverallIntent: Hateful; overall-intent-description: The image depicts a group of Black men, some wearing head coverings and one in a garment with a Star of David, with the text overlay 'we were known as hebrew israelites until slavery.' This juxtaposition attempts to equate Black people with Hebrew Israelites, a religious group that claims descent from the ancient Israelites, and implies that their identity was 'replaced' or 'changed' by slavery. This is a hateful and historically inaccurate claim that attempts to delegitimize the religious and cultural identity of Black people of African descent, particularly those who identify as Hebrew Israelites. It is rooted in antisemitic tropes that falsely equate Black people with Jews, and it is also a form of racial stereotyping that attempts to erase the distinct history and identity of African Americans. The meme is intended to provoke division and reinforce harmful stereotypes about Black identity and religious affiliation.
